examples.japanese: {毎週|まいしゅう}{日曜日|にちようび}に{教会|きょうかい}へ{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I go to church every Sunday.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}は{教会|きょうかい}で{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: The wedding was held at a church.

examples.japanese: あの{教会|きょうかい}は{古|ふる}くて{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: That church is old and beautiful.

notes:
{教会|きょうかい} refers to a Christian church building or congregation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {教会|きょうかい}に{行|い}く: to go to church
- {教会|きょうかい}で{結婚式|けっこんしき}を{挙|あ}げる: to have a wedding at a church
- {教会|きょうかい}{音楽|おんがく}: church music

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, church weddings are popular even among non-Christians due to their romantic aesthetic. Many wedding halls have chapel-style venues.

RELATED:
- {寺|てら}: Buddhist temple
- {神社|じんじゃ}: Shinto shrine
- キリスト{教|きょう}: Christianity
